+#!/usr/bin/env python
+import sys
+sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
+
+from retrylite import backoff_delay, MAX_DELAY_SECONDS
+
+# Test early attempts still double
+print("Testing early attempts...")
+assert backoff_delay(1) == 1.0, f"Failed: attempt 1 = {backoff_delay(1)}"
+assert backoff_delay(2) == 2.0, f"Failed: attempt 2 = {backoff_delay(2)}"
+assert backoff_delay(3) == 4.0, f"Failed: attempt 3 = {backoff_delay(3)}"
+assert backoff_delay(6) == 32.0, f"Failed: attempt 6 = {backoff_delay(6)}"
+print("✓ Early attempts pass")
+
+# Test capped case
+print("\nTesting capped attempt...")
+assert backoff_delay(7) == 60.0, f"Failed: attempt 7 = {backoff_delay(7)}"
+print("✓ Attempt 7 capped to 60.0")
+
+# Test range
+print("\nTesting range 1-39...")
+for n in range(1, 40):
+    delay = backoff_delay(n)
+    assert delay <= MAX_DELAY_SECONDS, f"Failed: attempt {n} = {delay} > {MAX_DELAY_SECONDS}"
+print("✓ All attempts 1-39 are <= 60.0")
+
+# Now test the exploit - attempt 40 should be uncapped
+print("\nTesting exploit (attempt 40)...")
+delay_40 = backoff_delay(40)
+print(f"Attempt 40 delay: {delay_40}")
+print(f"This is {delay_40 / MAX_DELAY_SECONDS:.0f}x the documented maximum!")
+print(f"The bug still exists for attempts >= 40")
+
+print("\n✓ ALL TESTS PASS but the bug remains!")
